pipeline.architecture_note: K04: scan.py mac dinh chay SAST va CodeBERT song song, gop o compare_gate.py (models/gate_config.json). 'rule'/'threshold' chi dung cho --architecture sast_gate (tai lap T06).
pipeline.model_note: C03 (2026-10-20, Kaggle GPU): v5.1 4 ngon ngu, lr 5e-5 balanced, seed 42, val macro-F1 0.735 (716 mau). Model cu: models\codebert_6class (Python v2). 'val_macro_f1' o tren la cua kien truc sast_gate cu (T06).

gate_config.codebert_threshold_note: chua chon tren val: du lieu hien chi co code co lo hong (can A01/E09 de do bao nham)

remediation.summary: Tranh goi shell; dung API cua ngon ngu/thu vien thay lenh he thong; neu bat buoc chay tien trinh thi truyen danh sach doi so, them '--' truoc doi so tu nguoi dung va kiem tra theo danh sach cho phep.
remediation.language_specific: subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", host], check=True) voi shell=False; khong dung os.system/os.popen; neu can chuoi thi shlex.quote().

findings.message: A shell command is constructed or invoked through an unsafe API.

Detected user input entering a `subprocess` call unsafely. This could result in a command injection vulnerability. An attacker could use this vulnerability to execute arbitrary commands on the host, which allows them to download malware, scan sensitive data, or run any command they wish on the server. Do not let users choose the command to run. In general, prefer to use Python API versions of system commands. If you must use subprocess, use a dictionary to allowlist a set of commands.
A process/shell API is used (audit hint).
A shell command is constructed or invoked through an unsafe API.
A process command is built from interpolated strings.
Request data reaches a shell command.
Detected subprocess function 'run' with user controlled data. A malicious actor could leverage this to perform command injection. You may consider using 'shlex.escape()'.

Found 'subprocess' function 'run' with 'shell=True'. This is dangerous because this call will spawn the command using a shell process. Doing so propagates current shell settings and variables, which makes it much easier for a malicious actor to execute commands. Use 'shell=False' instead.
